title: (No AI) Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
author: Jacob Kastrenakes
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/lcimg-d4d3d179-80e9-4873-9d38-24ac84737e8d.webp?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent. The product, called Muse Charm, was briefly shown off by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the end of tonight's Meta Connect presentation. It looks almost like a chunky smartwatch without the strap - just a big screen, plus a little lanyard for carrying the device around.

The Muse Charm has a fingerprint sensor on the top right corner that you can press to activate and begin speaking to the agent. There appears to be a small camera on the device as well, plus what looks like at least three holes for microphones on the front. Zuckerberg said you don't have to unlock a phone or …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/999750/muse-charm-meta-ai-hardware)

title: (No AI) Muse is coming to Meta smart glasses
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![A promotional image of a person using the Hearing Enhancement feature on Meta AI glasses](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Copy-of-Hearing-enhancement-16x9-1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Just a couple of weeks after [launching Muse](https://www.theverge.com/tech/993391/meta-muse-ai-hands-on), Meta announced that it's "working on" bringing the agent to its smart glasses, including the new glasses it unveiled at Meta Connect. Users will be able to activate Muse from their glasses by saying its name and ask it to handle tasks like guiding a workout, logging meals, or [helping them shop for products](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/999526/meta-muse-ai-agent-hands-on-shopping) they're looking at.

Muse is just one of several major updates coming to Meta's glasses. They're also getting some new accessibility features, like a Hearing Enhancement feature Meta says is "FDA-cleared software for adults with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss." It will be available lat …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/999673/meta-connect-2026-muse-glasses-features)
